scope: Partition of stale-index failures by what the retrieved stale context actually contained. A failure is an item where the stale index scores at least --fail-margin F1 below the live index.

categories.answer_present: gold string was in the stale context and the model still missed it (reading failure, not staleness)
categories.grounded_outdated: gold absent from context; answer traceable to the stale context (faithful reading of superseded evidence)
categories.ungrounded: gold absent from context; answer not traceable to it (parametric fallback or fabrication)

interpretation: THIS IS A LEXICAL HEURISTIC, NOT AN ADJUDICATED LABEL. 'grounded' is content-word overlap between the answer and the retrieved text. It cannot distinguish a faithfully-read superseded fact from a coincidental lexical match, and it cannot check that the answer is actually the OUTDATED version of the fact rather than an unrelated string that happens to appear in a news article. The headline share should therefore be read as an UPPER BOUND on faithful-stale-reading and a LOWER BOUND on the complementary hallucination share. We report two sensitivity analyses in place of the human audit this needs: a threshold sweep over the overlap cutoff, and a strict contiguous-span rule that is a different notion of grounding rather than a tighter version of the same one. The answer_present category is the internal control: items in it are reading failures rather than staleness failures, so the staleness categories are not inflated by generic model error.
validation_status: NOT VALIDATED AGAINST HUMAN JUDGEMENT. A blinded audit of a random sample is required before any specific percentage is quoted as the rate of faithful stale reading.
